key_patterns: CRITICAL: tiles render from scenes/tiles/<surface>-mesh.tres, NOT from unit_hex_*.tscn (those are unused by gameplay). hex_grid.gd lines 270-279 preload each *-mesh.tres into mesh_map; _generate_grid() (~line 6411) makes ONE MultiMeshInstance3D per SurfaceType with mm.mesh = mesh_map[surf_type], so ALL tiles of a surface type share the StandardMaterial3D embedded as the FIRST sub_resource of that *-mesh.tres. Surface reuse: TREE->fairway-mesh, FLAG->green-mesh, TEE->teebox-mesh. Tile world pos: x=col*1.5, z=row*sqrt(3)+(col%2)*sqrt(3)/2, Basis(UP, PI/6), Y-stretch 2.5x. Mowing stripes MUST use world-space XZ in a shader ((MODEL_MATRIX*vec4(VERTEX,1)).xz), not UV, since all instances share one mesh. Trees: placed one-scene-instance-per-TREE-cell in _generate_grid() loop (~line 6545) from TREE_SCENES [trees.tscn, trees-2.tscn, trees-3.tscn], each given random scale/rot + a StaticBody3D+CylinderShape3D collision + group 'trees' + _apply_random_tree_colors() (~line 6800). The three tree scenes are imported low-poly FBX MeshInstance3D meshes using StandardMaterial3D with vertex_color_use_as_albedo=true + gradient albedo_texture + emission_enabled=true. _apply_random_tree_colors() ONLY touches CSGSphere3D children -> it is a NO-OP for the real trees; recolor must move to the vertex-color/shader material. scripts/tree_spawner.gd is attached to an INERT node (visible=false, no tree_scenes) and is NOT the active placement path. Env: active WorldEnvironment=Environment_rvr3e (GOLF.tscn L38-55): sky bg, tonemap 2, sdfgi_use_occlusion, glow_intensity=6.49, distance fog (begin100/end180), volumetric fog density 0.013, ProceduralSkyMaterial_cdobm (bright blue). DirectionalLight3D (L246) is visible=false energy=0.4. Second Environment_fkwjp+World3D_eulkx (L81-84) feed a SubViewport, not main view. textureFloor (L~424) is a 400x400 animated-cloud-shader backdrop plane. Reusable shaders in scripts/: water.gdshader, floor.gdshader, ice.gdshader, flag.gdshader; outline.gdshader is a sphere-MASK (NOT a true outline). Leaf textures at models/leaves/leaves-0[1-6].jpg.
